title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and simplify cache parallelism
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR consolidates multiple repository CI workflows (lint/test/release) into a smaller set of coordinated workflows, simplifies cache parallelism logic, and updates a handful of dev dependencies for hygiene. Motivation: the existing GH Actions matrix had duplicated steps across several workflows which made maintenance and cache behavior brittle; teams saw intermittent cache misses and prolonged CI times when matrix concurrency exceeded runner capacity. Goals: (1) unify lint and test pipelines into a shared reusable job matrix to reduce duplication; (2) centralize release automation steps into a dedicated release workflow with explicit dry-run gating; (3) implement a deterministic cache key and linearized parallelism strategy to avoid runner contention while preserving fast cache reuse; (4) bump a few dev deps (actions/cache v4 -> v5, node-setup actions) and cleanup deprecated workflow triggers. Checklist: - [x] consolidate lint/test workflows into .github/workflows/ci.yml - [x] add reusable jobs and call sites for SDK packages - [x] implement deterministic cache keys and concurrency lock script - [x] update release workflow to use dry-run step and tag sanity checks - [x] run full CI and fix failing tests from dependency bumps - [x] document changes in docs/ci.md Notes: this is a maintenance/refactor PR (no runtime behavior changes) but customers may observe faster CI and more stable cache hits. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and follow-ups.
